Harper V: heads-up: company all-hands Monday 9:30am PT. short agenda: (1) exec snapshot + hiring priorities (10m) (2) policy announcement: hosted logs & PII handling (8m) (3) Dedicated launch operational notes + console changes (10m) (4) live Q&A + 5-min takeaway. please drop quick Qs here.
Sung J: quick Q — what retention windows are we announcing?
Harper V: summary: Hosted default retention moves to 60-day rolling by default for production; non-prod defaults to 14 days. Enterprise/Dedicated customers can opt into extended retention (180 days) via paid add-on. we'll show the customer-facing blurb.
Elena R: ops: we'll demo the new console UI for the "Retention & Privacy" panel and the Dedicated opt-in toggle. also showing the migration timeline and dry-run steps.
Mark D: can we include a short "engineer action checklist"? helps reduce followups.
Harper V: yes — final slide will have a "What engineering teams should do" two-bullet checklist. example snippets and header change included.
Elena R: sample header for teams consuming raw logs: ```
X-RW-PII-SCRUB: on
```
Sung J: any immediate billing impact?
Elena R: no billing changes for default windows. Extended retention (180d) for Dedicated is a billable option; we'll include examples and a price ballpark.
Harper V: accessibility: live captions enabled, and RecordingBot will post the transcript + recording within ~1 hour after the meeting.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — All-Hands Mon 9:30am PT — reminders set for 24h and 30m.
RecordingBot: recording + transcript will be uploaded to internal drive and linked here post-meeting. captions on.
Harper V: drop Qs here and we'll triage into the live Q&A. see you Monday! :eyes:
What engineering teams should do: 1) Audit ingestion clients for the new PII header and update if needed. 2) Validate console toggle behavior in any Dedicated staging tenants.
Elena R: adding: we'll publish a short migration-runbook and an opt-in customer notification cadence (30/14/3 days).
